headline: Anthropic shuts down Fable 5 & Mythos 5 after White House order
summary: US government demands Anthropic block foreign access to its most powerful AI models over national security concerns, leading to a complete shutdown for all users.
details: Anthropic has completely shut down access to its latest AI models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5, following a directive from the White House to block foreign nationals. The company stated that while complying with the order, it disagrees that a "narrow potential jailbreak" should warrant recalling a widely deployed commercial model.

The directive reportedly stemmed from concerns that Fable 5 could be used to serve information for cyberattacks, a finding allegedly shared by Amazon CEO Andy Jassy with the White House. There are also reports suggesting the White House feared access by a group linked to China, which could pose a significant national security risk.

Fable 5 was launched on June 9th, with Anthropic describing it as exceeding the capabilities of any model they had previously made generally available. Mythos 5 shared the same underlying model but with certain safeguards lifted. The sudden shutdown impacted all customers, including Anthropic's own foreign-born researchers.

Anthropic claims the government did not provide specific details of its national security concerns and that any evidence of potential jailbreaks was verbal. The company also noted that similar vulnerabilities, if they exist, are present in other models, including GPT 5.5.
